01 · What is different here

The pressures we see in enterprise

Pilots without owners

Teams adopt tools and agents faster than governance can list them. An inventory with owners and risk tiers is the first control, and most estates do not have one.

Many teams, no shared design

When several teams use coding agents, the architecture drifts. A single documented source of truth, and rules that fail in CI when code breaks them, keep it coherent.

Value nobody can show

Spending on AI is easy to count and hard to tie to outcomes. Measure before and after, with method a finance team can inspect.
